# Code Link

> Code Link 2.0 brings Windows terminals to Android phones and tablets over the internet. Your PC is the server. Maintained by ZARADEE.

Monitor Windows terminal output, scroll, tap interactive terminal buttons, open landscape fullscreen, send text and keys, handle approvals, and receive individual (A) or grouped (B) completion notifications on Android. Internet access uses encrypted iroh connections with direct paths where possible and free public relay fallback. No server rental or separate phone VPN is required. The PC must stay on and awake. USB, Bluetooth and LAN remain available. The current release is 2.0.0. Windows / Android offer zh-CN and en packages; Apple clients use English. Package filenames identify the language.

## Crawling

Public website pages contain static HTML, canonical and hreflang links, and SoftwareApplication metadata. The sitemap is https://zaradee.github.io/code_LINK/sitemap.xml. This documentation index is a supplemental convention. Project-path robots.txt is a template for the user-site root and does not override root crawling policy.

## Scope

Targets: Windows x64, Android 9+ ARM64, macOS 14+ and iOS / iPadOS 17+. Existing Windows Terminal mappings follow the active tab. External terminal completion detection requires supported screen markers; structured Codex events are available through clink codex. Remote access has been verified between a campus-network PC and Android on a hotspot or cellular data, including an unplugged screen-off completion alert. Overnight reliability has not been validated. LAN is implemented but hardware acceptance is pending. Apple clients use local TLS; macOS runs managed PTYs and local Codex sessions. iOS pauses in the background. There is no signed iPhone IPA or TestFlight release; a simulator app and personal-signing source are provided. Mac apps are ad-hoc signed and not notarized. Linux and WSL remain unvalidated. Code uses MIT; supplied artwork and third-party components have separate terms.
